title: Reddit to halt public Data API access in March 2027 as 14,000 apps register
source_used: PPC Land (citing TechCrunch and Reddit's own posts)
key_facts: Reddit said on 30 Sep 2026 it will stop serving RSS feeds on 13 Nov 2026 and close the remaining public Data API access in March 2027.
New public API requests stop on 31 Oct 2026; access for apps and users that have not registered starts to be removed from 12 Jan 2027.
More than 14,000 apps and bots have registered, according to Reddit; DeltaBot, MagicEyeBot and RemindMeBot named as migrated or nearly migrated.
Apps are expected to move to Reddit's Devvit Developer Platform, which does not support Python; a $1,000,000 migration programme pays $1,000 to eligible apps that apply by 30 Nov 2026.
For RSS outside communities a user moderates, Reddit's post says there is no replacement.
TechCrunch said API access will be removed for unregistered developers after 12 Jan; Reddit's wording is looser (access 'starts to close').
One developer says five months of negotiation produced two contracts and objects to a liability cap.
quote_evidence: Reddit said on September 30, 2026 that it will stop serving RSS feeds on November 13 and close what remains of public access to its Data API in March 2027
"If you use RSS for feeds outside of a community you moderate, there is no replacement," the post states
More than 14,000 apps and bots have registered, according to Reddit
why_it_matters_hint: Moderators, researchers and AI assistants relying on the free API or RSS must migrate or sign agreements.
notes: Follow-up of the 30 Sep TechCrunch story (in the 1 Oct pool). PPC Land adds registration count, bounty and developer reaction.
